hero.title: Discover Your Moon
hero.subtitle: Your living lunar calendar — current phase, tonight's ritual, and a private space for your intentions.

footer.note: Full moon dates are calculated using Meeus astronomical algorithms and verified against USNO and NASA references. Traditional moon names and magical correspondences follow established folk and astrological conventions.

whispers.New Moon: A blank page, a held breath. What do you wish to call in?
whispers.Waxing Crescent: The seed has been planted. Tend it with intention and patience.
whispers.First Quarter: Resistance is part of the path. Take one deliberate step forward.
whispers.Waxing Gibbous: You are almost there. Refine, adjust, and trust the momentum.
whispers.Full Moon: Everything you have tended is now visible. Receive it with gratitude.
whispers.Waning Gibbous: Share what you have learned. Generosity deepens the harvest.
whispers.Last Quarter: What no longer serves you? Release it with grace, not regret.
whispers.Waning Crescent: Rest. Reflect. The cycle is completing itself in its own time.
